nodes.label: When More Thinking Hurts: Overthinking in LLM Test-Time Compute Scaling
nodes.author: Shu Zhou, Rui Ling, Junan Chen, Xin Wang, Tao Fan, Hao Wang

nodes.label: Overthinking Phenomenon in LLMs
nodes.rationale: Extended reasoning associated with models abandoning previously correct answers, driven by diminishing marginal returns at higher compute budgets

nodes.label: Marginal Utility Analysis
nodes.rationale: Measurement of incremental benefit of additional reasoning tokens, showing diminishing returns and negative utility at high budgets

nodes.label: Flip Event Tracking
nodes.rationale: Tracks answer changes across budgets, categorizing positive flips (incorrect→correct) and negative flips (correct→incorrect) to measure overthinking

nodes.label: Cost-Aware Evaluation Framework
nodes.rationale: Balances accuracy against compute cost through tunable λ parameter, enabling efficiency frontier analysis

edges.rationale: Both concern maintaining coherent reasoning chains and mapping between representations

hyperedges.label: LLM Reasoning Limitations in Scientific Tasks
hyperedges.rationale: Three papers identify distinct failure modes: overthinking from diminishing returns, difficulty with conceptual restructuring, and prevalence of formulaic/conceptual errors in frontier physics
